flags.why: In this example, hạ vị names the lower central abdominal region, rather than meaning simply “lower” ([hospital reference](https://bvnguyentriphuong.com.vn/noi-tieu-hoa/kham-thuc-the-he-tieu-hoa)).
flags.fix: hypogastrium; the lower central region of the abdomen

flags.why: The example uses hải đường to mean a crabapple, not the genus Malus.
flags.fix: Chi hải đường gồm nhiều loài cây ăn quả và cây cảnh. = The genus Malus includes many fruit trees and ornamental trees.

flags.why: This expression is mainly Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([regional vocabulary reference](https://www.lyhuong.net/au/index.php/bd/27-27)).
Hầm cầu is primarily Southern usage, whereas Northern usage generally favors bể phốt.
The entry omits the common meaning of illness or complications suffered after childbirth ([dictionary reference](https://tudientv.com/?t=h%E1%BA%ADu+s%E1%BA%A3n)).
flags.fix: illness or complications occurring after childbirth

flags.why: The example defines the expression instead of using it.
flags.fix: Số thế giới được nhắc đến trong kinh nhiều hơn hằng hà sa số. = The number of worlds mentioned in the scripture exceeds the number of grains of sand in the Ganges.
